data_year: 2025 (annual observed driving data; edition released in 2026)
geography: TomTom-defined London City Area (urban core); do not equate without boundary validation to the full administrative city or metro area
population: Anonymized observed vehicle/GPS driving data across road network; not a resident or school-student survey
definition: Average all-days 24/7 driving travel time per 10 km. TomTom calculates aggregate travel time divided by aggregate km driven over directed road segments; the 10-km value is a standardized road-network driving measure, not average home-to-school commute time. Rush-hour measures are separate.
evidence: Official city page heading "London traffic in 2025", All days / 24/7, card Average travel time for a 10 km drive: 36 min 22 s. Conversion 36+22/60=36.366666667; rounded to 3 decimals is 36.367. Official methodology: Travel time for one kilometer = sum of all traversal times / sum of km driven; City Area and Metro Area defined separately.
issue: 数值和2025数据年相符；只有秒转分钟的正常四舍五入。原表来源缺少具体网址及City/24-7口径。若用于高中生通学时长则构念不符。
recommended_action: 保留36.367 min/10 km并补充2025、TomTom City Area、全年24/7；如希望按原展示精度，可写36 min 22 s。不要转称学生平均通学时间。
source_access_method: TomTom official source read through web index and HTTP200 direct requests; saved complete HTML and extracted text
limitations: City boundary geometry not independently digitized or validated in this audit. Publisher summary verified; raw individual GPS observations are not publicly reproduced.

original_source: doc: Ookla Speedtest Global Index September 2026
geography: Ookla Speedtest Global Index city entry Seoul; not country ranking; exact municipal boundary not established by retrieved methodology
population: Speedtest measurement sample satisfying publisher Precision Threshold; not a census or representative random sample of every household/student
definition: Median download speed (Mbps), Fixed Broadband city ranking. September 2026 is the report label; since June 2024 reported monthly values use current month plus previous two months. Official about page says fixed broadband includes mobile WiFi results; sample uses Precision Threshold with 95% confidence interval limits within ±5% of median.
evidence: Official HTTP200 city HTML: Seoul Median City Speeds Updated September 2026; Fixed Broadband Rank 34, Download 238.52 Mbps, Upload 177.41 Mbps, Latency 4 ms. Global Index fixed city list independently repeats value and rank. Official about page explicitly says monthly values use a rolling quarter including current month and previous two months; results updated mid-month for previous month.
issue: 原值、固定宽带/城市层级和2026年9月标签均获官方页面证实；原表未写三个月滚动统计窗口，不能称2026全年或仅9月单月测量值。
recommended_action: 保留238.52 Mbps；注明Ookla城市固定宽带下载中位数，September 2026版，测量滚动窗口2026年7—9月，并链接归档官方页面。
source_access_method: Official speedtest.net HTTP200 using requests. web tool direct open failed; unofficial proxy/mirror search hits were not used as verification evidence.
limitations: No original individual Speedtest measurement records or publisher-defined city polygon obtained. Values verified against publisher summaries, not recomputed from raw tests. Incorrect plain-ASCII Zurich URL returns 404; successful official city parameter is Zürich (URL encoded).
